services.title: Services
services.description: Everything customers can book, in the order they see it.
services.duplicateHint: The copy starts hidden so you can adjust it before customers see it.

list.archivedUpcoming: {count, plural, one {# upcoming booking} other {# upcoming bookings}} will still go ahead.
list.restored: {name} restored as hidden — review and publish it.
list.emptyBody: Create your first service to start taking bookings. Add options like length, size or add-ons that change the price and time.
list.optionGroups: {count, plural, one {# option group} other {# option groups}}
list.bookedThisMonth: {count, plural, one {# booked this month} other {# booked this month}}
list.archiveBody: Customers won't be able to book it. Existing appointments keep every detail and go ahead as planned. You can restore it any time.

archivedNotice.title: This service is archived
archivedNotice.body: Customers can’t book it and it’s hidden from your profile. Past bookings keep their details. Restore it to edit — it comes back hidden so you can review it first.

errors.rangeMax: Must be higher than the starting price
errors.name: Name your service
errors.form: A few things need your attention — they're highlighted below.

basics.title: Basics
basics.name: Service name
basics.namePlaceholder: e.g. Skin fade, Gel extensions, 1:1 training
basics.descriptionHint: What's included and what to expect. Shown on your profile.
basics.menuSectionHint: Groups services on your profile, e.g. “Cuts”.
basics.categoryHint: Helps customers find it in search.

price.title: Price & time

typeHint.starting_at: Shown as “From $X” — the final price depends on the work.
typeHint.quote: No price shown. You'll agree the price after talking with the customer.

price.saleHint: Shown with the original crossed out.

options.title: Options & add-ons
options.lead: Let customers choose things like length, size, design or extras. Each choice can change the price and the time it takes.
options.empty: No options — customers book the service as is.
options.shortenNote: Some choices shorten the service — the shortest combination is still at least 5 minutes.

who.title: Who & where
who.offeredAtHint: Leave all unchecked to offer it everywhere.
who.groupBookingsHint: More than 1 lets several people book the same time, like a class.
who.upTo: {count, plural, one {Up to # person} other {Up to # people}}

rules.title: Booking rules
rules.approveHint: Good for long or custom work.
rules.paymentsOff: Online payments aren't connected yet — customers will pay in person until they are.
rules.minNoticeHint: Overrides your business setting for this service.
rules.daysAhead: {count, plural, one {# day ahead} other {# days ahead}}

questions.title: Questions & requirements
questions.lead: Ask what you need to know before the appointment. Keep it short — every question adds friction.
questions.createForms: Create reusable question sets in <link>Settings → Client questions</link>.
questions.instructionsHint: Shown before they confirm, e.g. “Arrive with clean, dry hair”.
questions.consentHint: Customers must tick to accept it. We store when they did.

photo.title: Photo
photo.hint: Show your real work. Portfolio posts can also link to this service with “Book this”.

editor.visibleOff: Hidden — only your team can book it.

availability.title: Hours & time off
availability.emptyBody: Turn on bookings for a team member to set their working hours.
availability.savedBody: New bookings follow these hours right away.
availability.blockRemoved: Time off removed — those hours are bookable again
availability.overrideRemoved: Back to regular hours for that day
availability.descriptionSelf: When you can be booked. Changes apply to new bookings immediately; existing appointments stay put.
availability.descriptionOther: When {name} can be booked. Existing appointments stay put.
availability.weeklySummary: {hours} hrs a week · {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
availability.datesBody: Replaces the weekly hours for that day only — late opening, short day, or a day off.
availability.timeOffBody: Vacations, appointments of your own, breaks. Nobody can book over these.
availability.invalid: Some times overlap or end before they start
availability.removeBlockBody: {label} becomes bookable again under the weekly hours.
availability.removeOverrideBody: {label} will follow the weekly hours again.

override.errorRange: Each time range needs an end after its start.
override.errorDate: Choose today or a future date.
override.title: Change hours for one day
override.description: Existing appointments that day aren't moved or cancelled.

team.title: Team
team.description: Who works here, what they can see, and who customers can book.
team.removedUpcoming: They still have {count, plural, one {# upcoming appointment} other {# upcoming appointments}} — reassign or cancel them from the calendar.
team.headcount: {people, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} · {bookable, plural, one {# takes bookings} other {# take bookings}}
team.seats: {plan} plan: {used} of {count, plural, one {# bookable seat} other {# bookable seats}} used
team.expiresIn: {count, plural, one {expires in # day} other {expires in # days}}
team.showFormer: {count, plural, one {Show # former member} other {Show # former members}}
team.hideFormer: {count, plural, one {Hide # former member} other {Hide # former members}}
team.formerNote: Former members keep their past appointments in your records. To bring someone back, invite them again.
team.cancelInviteBody: The invite link stops working immediately.
team.removeBody: They lose access right away and stop appearing on your profile. Their past appointments stay in your records.
team.removeBodyUpcoming: They have {count, plural, one {# upcoming appointment} other {# upcoming appointments}} you'll need to reassign or cancel.
team.customUpgrade: Available on Pro and Business plans.

business.manage: Edit business profile, booking rules and policies

team.manage: Invite, edit and remove team members

schedule.manage_all: Edit everyone's schedule and time off
schedule.manage_own: Edit own schedule and time off

appointments.manage_all: Create, change and cancel any appointment

customers.manage: Edit customers, tags and internal notes

messages.manage: Read and reply to customer messages

inviteDialog.description: They'll get an email with a link to join. They sign in with that email address.

fields.name: Name
fields.seatsFull: All {count} bookable seats on your {plan} plan are in use.
fields.bookableHintInvite: Shows them on your profile once they've set their hours.
fields.bookableHintEdit: Turn off for front-desk staff or people on leave.
fields.bioHint: A line or two about their specialties. Shown on your profile.
fields.worksAtHint: Leave all unchecked if they work at every location.
fields.commissionHint: Used in Insights to estimate what you owe them. Not paid out automatically.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: Photos and videos of your work, shown in the Work section of your profile. Link a piece to a service and customers can book it in one tap.
portfolio.added: {count, plural, one {# item added to your portfolio} other {# items added to your portfolio}}
portfolio.featuredToast: Featured — it now shows first on your profile
portfolio.formats: Photos (JPG, PNG, WebP) and videos (MP4, MOV, up to 3 minutes). You can select several at once.
portfolio.emptyBody: Customers look at past work before they book. Add a few recent pieces and link each one to a service so they can tap “Book this”.
portfolio.order: Shown on your profile in this order.
portfolio.orderLarge: Shown on your profile in this order, with the first one large.
portfolio.processingHint: It appears on your profile when ready.
portfolio.failedHint: Delete it and try exporting as MP4.
portfolio.deleteBody: It's removed from your public profile right away. This can't be undone.
portfolio.caption: Caption
portfolio.captionHint: What was done — e.g. “Mid skin fade with a textured crop”.
portfolio.serviceHint: Customers see a “Book this” button that opens this service.
portfolio.featureThisHint: Featured work shows first on your profile.

pair.errorBoth: Choose both a before and an after photo.
pair.title: Add a before & after
pair.description: Customers drag a slider to compare the two photos. Use the same angle and lighting if you can.
pair.serviceHint: Adds a “Book this” button on your profile.

embeds.name: {provider} {kindLower}
embeds.title: From your socials
embeds.description: Feature YouTube videos and Shorts, TikToks, Instagram posts and reels, Vimeo videos, SoundCloud tracks and Spotify releases in the Featured section of your profile. Players only load when a visitor presses play.
embeds.full: You're featuring {max} posts, the most a profile can show. Remove one to add another.
embeds.removeBody: It disappears from the Featured section right away. The post itself stays on your social account.
embeds.linkLabel: Link to a video, post or track
embeds.found: {name} found. Check the preview, then add it.
embeds.linkHint: Copy the link from the Share button on YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Vimeo, SoundCloud, Spotify, Apple Music, Apple Podcasts or Mixcloud.
embeds.captionHint: A line about it — e.g. “Mixed and mastered for Lina Vega”.
embeds.serviceHintAdd: Adds a “Book this” link under the post.
embeds.serviceHintEdit: Customers see a “Book this” link under the post.

category.title: Welcome, {name}. What do you offer?
category.lead: Pick the closest match. You can offer anything — this just helps customers find you.

kind.title: Is it just you, or a team?
kind.lead: You can add team members later either way.
kind.individualHint: Independent professional — your name or brand, your calendar.
kind.businessHint: Shop, studio, salon or agency with staff, roles and multiple calendars.

name.lead: This is the name customers see when they search and book.
name.pageHint: Your page: {url} — you can change it later.
name.timezoneHint: Your hours and bookings use this zone.

branding.title: Make a good first impression
branding.lead: A photo and one line about what you do go a long way. Both are optional and easy to change later.
branding.taglinePlaceholder: Precision fades and classic cuts in Williamsburg
branding.aboutPlaceholder: Your experience, your approach, what clients can expect.

location.locateError: We couldn't get your location. Customers will still see your address.
location.title: Where do appointments happen?
location.lead: Add your main place now. You can add more locations, travel areas or online sessions later.
location.placeNameHint: Shown to customers, e.g. your shop's name.
location.countryHint: Two letters, e.g. US, MX, ES
location.nearMePhysical: If you're at this address now, pin it so customers nearby can find you.
location.nearMeMobile: Pin where you're based so nearby customers can find you.

services.title: What can people book?
services.lead: Add everything you offer — as many services as you like. Options, add-ons, deposits and photos can be added later in Services.

hours.title: When can people book you?
hours.lead: Set your usual week. Breaks, days off and holidays can be added any time from your calendar.

policies.title: How should booking work?
policies.lead: Sensible defaults are already set. Customers see these rules before they confirm.
policies.instantHint: Open times are booked immediately. Most popular — customers love it.
policies.approveHint: You confirm or decline every booking. Unanswered requests expire after 48 hours.

payments.title: Getting paid
payments.lead: Customers can always pay you in person. Online payments let you take deposits, cut no-shows and receive tips.
payments.stripeBody: Takes about five minutes. Card details are handled by Stripe and never touch Kept’s servers.
payments.offBody: Online payments aren’t switched on for this platform yet. Customers will see that they pay at the appointment, and you can record payments from each booking.

preview.liveToast: Customers can now find and book you.
preview.liveLead: Your page is public and taking bookings.
preview.lead: Check your page, then go live. You can pause it any time.
